author: Dorian Stuart
text: I don't understand why so many people "hate" on the Readers. It is so much smaller, easy to carry in my purse and hold in my hand as opposed to my clunky phone and a quick touch on the button gives me an instant answer. If I had to get my much bigger phone out and open the app to check where I stand, it would drive me nuts (not to mention poor cell service areas, etc)!
